objectives.title: Warhead Deployment
objectives.description: Periodically multiple Warheads will spawn across the battleground.

objectives.title: Collect Warheads
objectives.description: Collect a Warhead to activate your Nuke. Use it quick or you will drop it when you die!

objectives.title: Call Down the Thunder
objectives.description: Launch Nukes to burn enemy team's fortifications.  Attack their structures to extend the burn!
